dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Good evening, I have a problem with my daughter... She's screaming, breaking things... Completely out of control!
{IS SHE HURT?} Is your daughter hurt?
{WHAT HAPPENED?} What happened?
I just can't calm her down! She's pulling my hair! She is almost my height...
dialogOption.COMMENT: Tutaj poprawka z 'call her down' na 'calm her down'

dialogOption.texten: {HOW OLD IS SHE?} How old is she?
{WANT US TO SHOOT HER?} So you want us to come and shoot her?
... What? Excuse me?!
{IT WAS SARCASM} Erm... it was just sarcasm, sorry Ma'am.
That was very inappropriate! I will file a complaint for that, I assure you sir! Goodbye!
dialogOption.COMMENT: Bez 'I pay my taxes', to nie brzmi

dialogOption.texten: {NOT A 911 SITUATION} Ma'am, it doesn't sound like a 911 situation. Please deal with your daughter yourself or call the education support.
But how? She breaks everything in her room! Send in someone! I need help!
{WHERE?} Where do you live?
We live at [[ADDRESS]]
We live at 112 1st street
We live at 246 2nd avenue
We live at 389 Pine street
{I'LL SEND THE POLICE} I'll send an officer to check up on her.
Thank you, bye...
{NOT AN EMERGENCY} As I said, it's not a case for 911. Goodbye.
Well... THANK YOU.
Oh, she broke something again...

reportElement.texten: A mother couldn't manage to calm her daughter down.
The caller filled a complaint on the operator's behavior.
The teenager was reprimanded by policemen.
